reviews.comment: Hands down one of the best professors I have had. She made the class expectations very simple and clear, and I believe it would be almost impossible to fail. I've also met with her a few times outside to discuss grad school plans and she gave me wonderful advice. Would recommend taking her for any class in this department!

As long as you study for her exams, you should be fine. She's a great lecturer. You can tell she that she is passionate in what she does and cares a lot about her students. She will responds to most to your emails and provide help as much as possible. Overall very fun class to take.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shelby is an amazing prof! She brings a great aspect to the ento/fivs department. Very kind, caring about her students. The tests are not hard as long as you study, but you might not do well if you don't.

I was fortunate to have Shelby for FIVS 422 and 210 this semester. She is easygoing, understanding, and accommodating to her students and their needs. Furthermore, Shelby grades quickly and always provides valuable feedback. She is also remarkably talented in public speaking and delivering entertaining lectures. In short, she's exceptional!
